name: SiteInductionAccessManager
tagline: Only inducted, competent workers on site – inductions, cards, tickets and the gate in one app.
description: A complete site induction and access app for construction: pre-register workers by employer, book and record inductions with assessment and safety briefing, track competency cards and tickets with expiry, decide access per worker and zone, check and sign workers in at the gate, see compliance per employer with chase emails and plan renewals – in one Power Apps code component for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Access decision per worker: granted, pending, blocked – with reasons
Induction booking and recording with pass mark and briefing confirmation
Competency cards with accepted schemes and expiry
Tickets with expiry and zone ticket rules
Gate check with sign-in / sign-out and GateResult output
Suspend, reinstate, revoke (with confirmation), left site
Employer compliance with chase emails and sign-out of blocked workers
Bulk actions with skipped-row reporting and undo
